In Angular applications, leveraging semantic HTML enhances SEO, accessibility, and maintainability. This tutorial will guide you through implementing semantic HTML effectively within your Angular projects."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Why Use Semantic HTML?"},{"order":4,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Improved SEO: Search engines prioritize semantic markup, leading to better rankings."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Enhanced Accessibility: Screen readers and other assistive technologies rely on semantic elements to interpret content correctly."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Better Maintainability: Semantic code is easier to read, understand, and maintain."},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Cross-Browser Compatibility: Semantic elements are generally well-supported across different browsers."},{"order":8,"type":"subheading","text":"Common Semantic HTML Elements"},{"order":9,"type":"bullet_point","text":"
